description: src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py defines 7 behavioural functions for provider registration, default loading, and URL/payload detection instead of pure package re-exports, and holon-coherence has no automated AST test blocking function or class definitions inside package __init__.py files.
goal: Move all 7 functions (register_provider, _load_default_providers, get_provider, _detect_by_url, _detect_by_payload, detect_provider_name, resolve_provider) and their registry state out of src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py into a new module src/holon_coherence/providers/registry.py (at most 200 lines), leaving src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py restricted strictly to public re-exports with zero function or class definitions and preserving all existing public imports and behaviour. Add tests/providers/test_init_no_logic.py proving via AST that every __init__.py under src/holon_coherence/ contains zero FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, or ClassDef definitions, and register both new files in tests/providers/test_providers_self_doc.py (keep zero docstrings and zero comments across all touched files). Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Package __init__.py files with behavioural logic cause circular-import hazards and import-time side effects; extracting providers/registry.py and adding a repo-wide AST guard locks the invariant.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/providers/registry.py holds the provider registry and detection functions within the 200-line module budget.

src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py re-exports register_provider, get_provider, detect_provider_name, resolve_provider, ProviderFormat, and related public symbols without defining any function or class.

tests/providers/test_init_no_logic.py inspects every __init__.py under src/holon_coherence/ via ast.parse and fails if any FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, or ClassDef exists (including a synthetic negative test case).
tests/providers/test_providers_self_doc.py includes src/holon_coherence/providers/registry.py and tests/providers/test_init_no_logic.py with zero docstrings or disallowed comments.
Existing provider tests (tests/providers/test_registry.py) and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass cleanly.
src/holon_coherence/providers/__init__.py (and all other src/holon_coherence/**/__init__.py) contains zero function or class definitions.
